environment: macOS 26.5.2 arm64; Node 24.14.0; npm 11.9.0; TypeScript 5.9.3; Playwright 1.61.1
checks: Consent preview lists selected resources and exact operations before route creation; rejection causes zero grant requests
Required direct and processor-backed legs reserve and recheck runtime grants before activation; downstream denial stops prepared routes
Missing selections, failed host binding, denied or expired grants and required member loss retry with fresh resolution, consent and route authority
Terminal stop releases output and fences an asynchronous late consent response
Offline packed SDK consumer checks TypeScript declarations and executes the consent-gated route in Node, Chromium, Firefox and WebKit
scope: E04 host-owned recipe session lifecycle for embedded routes. It uses static resolution, an explicit consent callback and the existing route-group controller; every attempt rereads inventory and obtains fresh runtime grants. Simulated direct and two-leg processor routes cover start, failure, loss, retry and stop. Host UI, real provider registration, processor byte verification and physical effects remain separate obligations; cancellation cannot undo an effect already performed.
